plan.notes: Official NJIT 2026-2027 catalog page 'B.S. in Information Technology', Plan of Study Grid (120 credits minimum; catalog prints Total Credits 120). Slot labels follow the catalog's labeled PDF edition: Science Literacy GER, Science Literacy with Lab GER, Social Science GER Elective, History and Humanities GER 200 level and 300+ level, Humanities and Social Science Senior Seminar GER, General Electives (7), and IT Major Elective Courses (8). COM 313 or COM 312 is a catalog choice. Specializations (e.g. Criminal Justice and Law) are optional and not included in the base plan. Per-term sums verified against the catalog's printed Term Credits (15/16/15/13/15/16/15/15 = 120).
